BiblicalUsage: Minni is a province of Armenia, named once. Jeremiah summons the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashchenaz to march against Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the summons shows God's reach: He calls nations from the far north to do His judging, and no empire is beyond His word.
